title: Wendell and the Silence
author: Ada Kavanagh
blurb: Rosalind Joubert, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
